## Recall: simplify fully

1. Simplify the expression on paper.
2. State the excluded value.

$\dfrac{6x^2-x-2}{3x-2}$

::: {.fragment}

The original denominator is zero at $x=\dfrac{2}{3}$. In the numerator, $P=-12$ and $S=-1$. The pairs $(1,-12),(2,-6),(3,-4)$ give sums $-11,-4,-1$. Choose $3,-4$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

$6x^2+3x-4x-2=3x(2x+1)-2(2x+1)=(3x-2)(2x+1)$

:::

::: {.fragment}

$\dfrac{(3x-2)(2x+1)}{3x-2}=2x+1,\quad x\ne\dfrac{2}{3}$.

:::
